sections.title: سبق 1 — متن (16)

paras.text: Allah Almighty has fixed a share in inheritance for both men and women from their parents and close relatives. We must act on it.

paras.text: People, fearing Allah Almighty, should take care of the wealth of orphans just as they wish that after their death the wealth of their young and helpless children be cared for.

sections.theory:
Matters of knowledge and action

Allah Almighty has fixed a share in inheritance for both men and women from their parents and close relatives. We must act on it.

People, fearing Allah Almighty, should take care of the wealth of orphans just as they wish that after their death the wealth of their young and helpless children be cared for.

If one who has sinned in ignorance repents immediately, Allah Almighty certainly accepts such repentance.

At the time when the state of death comes over one, neither is repentance accepted nor is believing beneficial. Therefore one must never delay in repenting, lest by persisting in sins the ability to repent be taken away or death come suddenly.

Men are commanded to treat their wives in the best way; they have been instructed to pay attention to the good qualities of their wives instead of their shortcomings.
